authority: Prospective technical design only; approved B01/B02 unchanged; not a complete/scored F1 oracle or authorization for any owner experiment.

cases.conditions: Refusal of setup or registration, NOT a P0 non-ACCEPT decision; no P0 terminal receipt; no qualifying frozen independent platform capability receipt.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: NOT_REALIZABLE must not be assigned; INCOMPLETE applies if no valid terminal P0 and no independently evidenced higher-priority failure
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: No REOPEN solely because Arm B was refused or not visited
cases.qualification_boundary: Non-ACCEPT P0 is an explicitly enumerated event terminal; without fixed other-arm viability and raw flags no global INVALID/REOPEN class follows.

cases.conditions: RP challenge issued AND delivered to the browser; same-attempt acceptance ID; trusted browser invocation of navigator.credentials.get() durably recorded; RP pending assertion consumed once with NotAllowedError/cancel/timeout receipt.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: WEBAUTHN_ASSERTION_NOT_COMPLETED is an event-terminal no-proof result under B01 only after actual owner assertion ceremony and required independent RP/client evidence.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Require correlated client-call invocation (not just RP timeout) and RP consumed-receipt; absence does not automatically prove a ceremony; NotAllowedError cause may be ambiguous and must be disclosed.
cases.qualification_boundary: Owner-approved B01 NotAllowedError still counts as terminal when all accepted prerequisites hold; no silent narrowing to voluntary owner cancellation.

cases.conditions: Browser claims NotAllowedError but no durable same-attempt pending assertion consumed receipt, while P0 remains without an enumerated terminal outcome
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: P0 cannot be counted event_terminal; incomplete evidence; not capability impossibility
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: G1 REOPEN cannot rely on the missing P0 event
cases.qualification_boundary: Missing receipt integrity flags may have higher precedence; no automatic permission for retry

cases.conditions: Arm B successfully completed same-attempt UV/ES256 registration; later assertion returns NotSupportedError; NO independent frozen capability receipt from the relevant operation/site exists.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Without the stipulated receipt, NOT_REALIZABLE is excluded, the NotSupportedError is event_terminal=false, and absent independent higher-priority fault evidence B evidence_state is INCOMPLETE. G1 REOPEN is excluded; instrument fault is NOT automatically inferred.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Define a reproducible independent assertion-capability probe tied to browser/OS/site and phase; test after successful registration, changed browser/profile/policy, and a missing or self-asserted receipt.
cases.qualification_boundary: Still blocked: whether a later independently proved assertion incapability may override earlier registration success, and exact receipt semantics. Do not infer global INVALID_INCOMPLETE if A eligible or integrity flag present.
cases.blocked_reason: Exact evidence/classification predicate remains unapproved; do not use as a frozen expected-score oracle.

cases.conditions: Known independently produced capability receipt with closed tests and verifiable negative support, but receipt grammar/signature/site not yet specified
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: If a future approved predicate is satisfied, NOT_REALIZABLE is potentially admissible
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: F1 closed receipt must identify producer and independent witness; browser, profile, OS, authenticator scope, registration vs assertion, attempt/acceptance binding, measurement clocks and replayable probe, with refusal/cancel/timeout/not-visited/expired negative cases.
cases.qualification_boundary: A hypothetical receipt cannot be treated as already valid or owner-approved
cases.blocked_reason: Exact evidence/classification predicate remains unapproved; do not use as a frozen expected-score oracle.

cases.conditions: Same-attempt registered public identity was already bound; trusted harness observation proves actual key-content/public-ID replacement after binding (not merely unreadable or AV-locked bytes).
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: INTEGRITY source flag true; INVALID / INVALID_INTEGRITY highest precedence
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Never downgrade to event-terminal owner stop or instrument repair simply because signing did not start
cases.qualification_boundary: Flag provenance and trusted invariant identity must be mechanically demonstrated

cases.conditions: After consumed claim, source-inventoried native ssh-keygen process creation is attempted and fails without any child exit status. Trusted statement, key and witness chain intact, and no earlier integrity flags.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: This specifically matches the postclaim process-launch INSTRUMENT site under REV04 L0203 and §8.6, subject to scorer-verified intact chain; other failure sites have different rules.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Pin independent precheck-versus-launch instrument sites: precheck inability, process-creation failure, and executed nonzero/no-signature are three different outcomes; no generic catch-all.
cases.qualification_boundary: Source-determined only for process creation failure at a §8.6 INVENTORIED site; not for a failed precheck or a native nonzero exit; global class conditional on absence of higher-priority integrity.

cases.conditions: Generic pre-sign failure with insufficient reliable source-specific evidence to distinguish real changed public identity/header/agent from unreadable bytes, missing executable or unexpected file.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: No generic precheck terminal outcome can be added to B01-approved COMPLETED vocabulary. Proven identity/contract violations are integrity, independently evidenced tool failures instrument, and unsupported/missing receipts cannot prove COMPLETED.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Create closed precheck-site list with proof of property mismatch versus unreadable check, evidence origin and phase, precise integrity/instrument flags, and no speculative new terminal_outcome.
cases.qualification_boundary: Blocked on evidence sufficiency and exact source site, not on the already approved integrity precedence. Adding PRECHECK_FAILED as a new terminal outcome would require a separately approved policy change.
cases.blocked_reason: Exact evidence/classification predicate remains unapproved; do not use as a frozen expected-score oracle.

cases.conditions: After registered postclaim key setup, pre-sign check proves the private key is no longer encrypted or wrong key type, OR the corresponding registered PUBLIC key header/member ID actually changed. Do not interpret simple KDF salt/passphrase re-encryption byte changes as unencrypted without a defined property check.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Only violation of the approved key-encryption property or registered public identity implies integrity. Byte change alone is insufficient for the L0206 public-header invariant.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Test same public key with changed passphrase and changed KDF salt, versus genuinely unencrypted key, wrong type and different public key. Disclose ambiguous mid-attempt passphrase-change policy.
cases.qualification_boundary: Any literal prohibition on passphrase changes during this attempt must be explicitly defined and disclosed; do not pretend an unproven private-header byte difference establishes public-key substitution.

cases.conditions: Verified Windows process-group/console isolation is in effect; HARNESS durable stream proves owner abort, then harness-initiated cleanup, then observed RP process exit; no earlier independent RP fault flag.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Harness abort-caused child termination is not a separately observed unexpected RP fault. When no cryptographic arm viable and P0/event missing without higher flags, G1 uses incomplete evidence, not a favorable instrument exception.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Test same-harness-stream event ordering with process isolation, Ctrl+C during blocked RPC, no isolation negative and true earlier harness-observed RP fault.
cases.qualification_boundary: Without verified isolation or reliable harness-order evidence this becomes the still-blocked S3-03 race, not an unconditional INVALID_INCOMPLETE.

cases.conditions: Verified Windows process isolation; HARNESS_RECORDED unexpected RP failure observed before any harness-recorded owner abort, with source-labelled no-owner-cause diagnosis; independent evidence chain intact and no integrity source flags.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Harness-recorded pre-abort independent RP fault sets node_rp_failure. Scorer may not derive that flag from RP-only stream or uncontrolled console-close effects. With no integrity flag the conditional result is INVALID_INSTRUMENT.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Negative test: RP self-reports crash without harness receipt, console CTRL_CLOSE_EVENT with no harness abort record, and true RP fault after A already eligible. Preserve flag-origin authority.
cases.qualification_boundary: A false RP-origin or unverified isolation may confer impermissible B02 instrument exception. Source site and cause must be independently evidenced.

cases.conditions: Owner Ctrl+C and RP process exit are durably observed on different streams; no verified happens-before relation or independently established harness-observed unprovoked fault meeting isolation preconditions.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: R4 L0215 requires a prospectively frozen deterministic INCOMPLETE-versus-INSTRUMENT rule; no favorable repairable INSTRUMENT may be inferred solely from uncertainty.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Test unknown temporal order, abort before cleanup, verified independent RP failure before abort, and Node exit during owner Ctrl+C with no verified isolation.
cases.qualification_boundary: INCOMPLETE-on-unorderable-race with specified rebuttal burden remains reviewer-proposed until independent technical decision. INSTRUMENT-by-ambiguity could alter B02 exception eligibility.
cases.blocked_reason: Exact evidence/classification predicate remains unapproved; do not use as a frozen expected-score oracle.

cases.conditions: A signed or unsigned assertion RP receipt is recovered after a harness interruption; the harness has not recorded completed in-run VERIFY for this particular event.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: No newly recovered successful assertion is allowed to become a retrospectively verified terminal VALID owner proof. Preserve bytes for later disclosure/check without changing consumed-attempt scored evidence. Proven earlier NotAllowedError event may remain terminal no-proof.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Synthetic RP-tail recovery tests: durable consumed no-proof with in-run event receipt vs late success without harness VERIFY; no cross-process resumption or favorable score change.
cases.qualification_boundary: Late RP evidence never substitutes for missing in-run VERIFY and cannot create proof viability ex post.

cases.conditions: Three native SSH sign invocations have trusted per-invocation nonzero exit/no-signature receipts; after 1 and 2 owner chose exact R; there was no Ctrl+C overlapping any in-flight call, no fourth call and no changed statement, decision, key or timer.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: B01 budget-exhaustion event is terminal without proof. Preserve raw contract token PROOF_NOT_CREATED and normalize the same three-call event losslessly to the approved policy enumeration SSH_UNLOCK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Positive three-call receipts + R,R; negatives one/two calls, owner S/non-R, partial file, zero exit, fourth call, missing receipt or Ctrl+C during third call. Canonical event token must be frozen as a representation-only alias.
cases.qualification_boundary: This does not expand COMPLETED or change the scoring class; a genuine Ctrl+C overrides alias to in-flight incomplete. Requires independent reviewer confirmation but no new owner interpretation.

cases.conditions: One or two nonzero no-signature invocations; owner chooses S/non-R at retry prompt; no Ctrl+C
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: OWNER_S_EVENT_STOP, not proof-budget exhaustion; event terminal no-proof
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Continue scheduled run without repeating failed event
cases.qualification_boundary: Only exactly uppercase R with no extra whitespace permits re-invocation. Lowercase r or R with trailing whitespace is non-R and ends the event; disclose the UX explicitly.

cases.conditions: Native SSH invocation exits nonzero with an unexpected signature file or exits zero without exactly one expected file
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: PARTIAL_OR_INCONSISTENT_OUTPUT; terminal event, not retryable budget exhaustion
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Without separate identity breach, not automatically attempt-level integrity
cases.qualification_boundary: Check all integrity/instrument source flags independently before the final whole-claim scored class; the event-local terminal outcome does not settle B01/B02.

cases.conditions: A free-text claim of three failed signing invocations, without trustworthy individual invocation/event terminal receipts
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Cannot mark the corresponding proof event COMPLETED solely on a free-text exhaustion label
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Missing required evidence may also trigger scorer-derived integrity flags; those flags have precedence
cases.qualification_boundary: Only trusted invocation receipts and event terminal evidence count; a narrative string never supplies completion, with independently derived integrity flags retaining precedence.

cases.conditions: During native inherited-console SSH attempt 3, owner Ctrl+C causes child exit nonzero/no sig before harness KeyboardInterrupt is observed.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: A third-call nonzero must not by itself turn a whole-run Ctrl+C into SSH budget exhaustion and false COMPLETED/REOPEN. Exact receipt/interrupt precedence is not yet frozen.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Test observed Windows console propagation, in-flight marker, signal/exit order, R selections and post-interrupt snapshot, including no false event completion.
cases.qualification_boundary: Block favorable classification on race without a prospective independently reviewed interrupt ordering/terminal rule.
cases.blocked_reason: Cross-family observation requires frozen proof/causal and interruption-evidence rules; cannot qualify a scored oracle yet.

cases.conditions: RP issues a challenge then expires it without durable evidence the browser ever invoked navigator.credentials.get(); no owner assertion event receipt exists.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: No evidenced owner ceremony event can be counted COMPLETED from a timer alone; pending state/other DOM client site error remains separately classified.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Distinguish server expiry-only from browser-invoked timeout, with shared acceptance ID and client/RP receipts; prevent G1 false REOPEN.
cases.qualification_boundary: Sufficient client-invocation evidence standard is a prospective technical qualification and must be independently reviewed.

cases.conditions: Owner Ctrl+C occurs while a same-directory temporary evidence snapshot is being promoted to the unique final filename on Windows; crash-atomic no-overwrite semantics not yet qualified.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: An observed malformed final snapshot must not silently be repaired or relabelled as an owner abort. Genuine integrity flags have precedence, so Windows atomicity must be qualified.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Crash-injection test of preflush, fsync, exclusive rename and postrename states, distinguishing orphan temporary file from malformed published final file.
cases.qualification_boundary: Until Windows write/rename atomicity and evidence integrity are independently qualified, cannot assume incomplete rather than integrity.
cases.blocked_reason: Cross-family observation requires frozen proof/causal and interruption-evidence rules; cannot qualify a scored oracle yet.

cases.conditions: Arm A is eligible, B registered successfully then NotSupportedError is self-labelled capability unavailable without an independently frozen assertion-capability proof.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: False B NOT_REALIZABLE suppresses required OTHER_ARM_INCOMPLETE G2 disclosure and can end the family with PASS; B cannot be marked NOT_REALIZABLE without approved receipt.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Counterexample compare B=INCOMPLETE versus qualifying B=NOT_REALIZABLE while A=eligible, with same attempt and higher-priority flags fixed false.
cases.qualification_boundary: B capability receipt protocol and postregistration causal criterion remain blocked; G2 owner disclosure must not be omitted.
cases.blocked_reason: Cross-family observation requires frozen proof/causal and interruption-evidence rules; cannot qualify a scored oracle yet.

cases.conditions: A completes eligible proofs, no integrity flag; a separately source-labelled unprovoked RP fault occurs, with verified isolation and HARNESS_RECORDED fault before any owner abort.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Valid instrument source has precedence over possible PASS and yields INVALID_INSTRUMENT. A mere RP crash/no harness evidence is insufficient.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Positive/negative harness-origin and isolation tests after completed eligible Arm A; preserve B02 exception significance, avoid false favorable instrument.
cases.qualification_boundary: Conditional global class: every earlier integrity flag independently false, genuine unprovoked fault documented, claim already consumed.

cases.conditions: After successful preclaim KAT, executable starts all three times and returns nonzero with no signature; owner enters exact R after calls 1 and 2, no exceptional launch/precheck/verification fault and no Ctrl+C.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Under the expressly permitted recurring native subprocess no-proof behavior, a three-call budget exhaustion may be event-terminal without proving wrong passphrase or a valid signature.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Synthetic contrast between process-launch failure (instrument) and deterministic no-signature native exit (budget); record timing, ensure no auto retry.
cases.qualification_boundary: Must not turn a true independently classified executable fault into a successful proof or recategorize B02 eligibility.

cases.conditions: A and B each nonviable with independently evidenced COMPLETED or NOT_REALIZABLE state, no higher-priority faults. Arm C has attestations but no A/B cryptographic evidence_state.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: G1 both-arm predicate refers to A and B only; Arm C cannot block or create REOPEN, and cannot become selected eligible cryptographic arm.
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Case with Arm C missing/present affirm same G1 branch when A/B and flags fixed; control negative owner role remains not eligible.
cases.qualification_boundary: Use only exact A/B G1 states; Arm C behavior does not waive completed-evidence requirement.
